what: Torn paper curtain — a WebGL panel covers the screen from above (or below·the side), its leading edge jagged like torn paper (5 layers of 2D gradient noise, depth .05·grain 3.5), with a band of bright inner paper (thickness .07) trailing right behind it. A large wave (.1) rises with the sine of progress, and the bend (.25 × sin(position along the progress direction × π)) makes the middle of the screen pass quickly, so at progress .5 70% of the screen is already covered — 2s power3.inOut. fx:in covers and fx:out clears, fx:done fires when finished, and fx:set sets progress directly. One curtain serves menu open (dark curtain)·page transition (flipped, from below, photo-slot pattern)·arrival page reveal (bright paper over a dark background)

options.dur: Duration (s), default 2 — at 0 it covers instantly
options.bow: Warp that speeds up the middle section of the travel direction, default .25
options.horizontal: If 1, covers from right to left (horizontal pages)
options.bg: Color variable for uncovered areas, default --fx-curtain-bg
options.start: If in, it covers as soon as it attaches (reveals the arrival page)
options.invert: If 1, it flips and covers from below (from the left when horizontal) — also given via detail.invert of fx:in

use: el.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fx:in', { detail: { cover: '--kf-contrast-bg', invert: true, placeholder: true } })) → fx:done fires on el · set progress manually: fx:set { p: .5 }
note: The original shader is not used, the value noise, arc bend and band thickness were rewritten to match the original numbers (amplitude .25 · rippedFrequency 3.5 · rippedAmplitude .05 · curveFrequency 1 · curveAmplitude .1 · rippedHeight .07 · 2s power3.inOut). ogl must be loaded first (library/_vendor/ogl@0.0.74/ogl.min.js or ogl@1.0.11).

from.where: shared.js menu curtain (.gl-canvas.above) · page transition · arrival reveal (.gl-canvas.below) — original PaperCurtainEffect (ogl 0.0.74)
